chunks: The day We shall gather all of them together and say to those who ascribe (partners to God): 'Where are the compeers who you claimed (were equal to God)?'
ai.seo_question: What does God ask the polytheists on the Day of Judgment regarding their false gods?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-An'am, this verse underscores the ultimate futility of shirk by contrasting the claimed power of idols with their actual silence on the Day of Resurrection. Shia exegesis highlights this as a moment of divine irony, where the 'partners' (shuraka') are exposed as mere creations incapable of intercession, reinforcing the concept of Tawhid as both theological truth and practical reality. The rhetorical question serves to dismantle the polytheists' confidence in their false allies, leaving them alone with their Creator.
